headline: Fixed the four rendering defects from the 2026-09-18 visual audit (#225 A3/A4/A5 + #226): radio ring/dot now take an explicit flex/block display so their token width/height actually apply (0px -> 20x20 ring, 8x8 dot); segmented-control's active indicator was losing bg-[accent] to its own base bg-transparent in the Tailwind cascade because it wasn't run through cn()/twMerge (1.00:1 -> 7.33:1 contrast) — same fix applied to the label+description text-color slot; toggle now draws a real 40x20 pill track + 16x16 thumb instead of rendering the native 16x16 checkbox directly; alert title/body are now a flex-col with a semantic-token gap instead of adjacent inline spans. All measured before/after in a real Chromium render (Playwright), not read off source. Note: #225 had already been closed by PR #228, but that PR only did an unrelated radius-token rename in toggle/segmented-control and never touched radio.tsx — the three rendering bugs were still live on main.
next: Adrian: decide B3 (body size/weight + border neutral) — two token values that set the register everything else is judged against; border is currently 1.26:1 against a 3:1 floor
Adrian: decide B1 (single radius source of truth — Tailwind rounded-md derives 10px while components bind the 12px token) and B4 (heading weight; the light-300 token is orphaned)
Correct DESIGN.source.md prose vs generated tables (A7), renumber the inverted 5xl/7xl scale (A8)
Enable Chromatic (#200) now that A3/A4/A5 render correctly, so the baseline captures a correct render
Add a rendered regression gate (renders radio/segmented-control/toggle/alert, asserts non-zero geometry + >=3:1 contrast) per #225's DoD — not built in this PR, see the follow-up issue
